name: betgenie
description: AI-Powered Sports Betting Intelligence Platform by Mohn Empire
author: Mohn Empire

scripts.deploy:hosting: cd apps/web && npm run build && firebase deploy --only hosting
scripts.deploy:all: cd apps/web && npm run build && firebase deploy
scripts.deploy:hosting:preview: cd apps/web && npm run build && firebase hosting:channel:deploy preview
scripts.gcp:enable-apis: gcloud services enable run.googleapis.com firestore.googleapis.com cloudbuild.googleapis.com cloudfunctions.googleapis.com cloudscheduler.googleapis.com
scripts.cloud-run:deploy:nba: cd cloud-services/nba_data_ingestion && gcloud run deploy nba-data-ingestion --source . --region=us-central1 --platform=managed
scripts.cloud-run:deploy:odds: cd cloud-services/odds_aggregation && gcloud run deploy odds-aggregation --source . --region=us-central1 --platform=managed
scripts.cloud-run:deploy:news: cd cloud-services/news_monitoring && gcloud run deploy news-monitoring --source . --region=us-central1 --platform=managed
scripts.cloud-run:deploy:ai: cd cloud-services/ai_analysis && gcloud run deploy ai-analysis --source . --region=us-central1 --platform=managed
